My Salutations to all Pious Souls...

Today was the 'ninth day' of the 'life force consecration' ceremony of the Shree Mangal Murti which is going to take place during the auspicious festival of Navratri. Today's Anushthan took place from 8.30am to 6.30pm.

The 'values' of inner-knowledge have been obtained by many doctors, engineers, ministers, but the 'inner-knowledge increases through distribution' – the 'announcer/narrator' sadhak who has come to know this secret, he is also the 'announcer/narrator' of this programme. Today's prayer to Paramatma has been rendered for that same announcer/narrator sadhak himself/herself may attain the 'karma-free state' in this life itself, after attaining which, there is nothing more left to attain in life. 'Inner-knowledge is such a wealth - the more you distribute it, that much more it will increase, this is the experience of my personal life too.

Lots of Blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
